summary: MOOD V2 Phase 1 — Event Tracking Expansion independently re-verified. Backend (14/14 pytest cases pass): /auth/register → user_registered (auth), /auth/login wrong→ login_failure (auth), correct → login_success (auth), /auth/logout → logout (auth) — all land in user_events with correct event_category. /subscription/validate (product_id=mood_premium_yearly, dummy signed_payload) emits subscription_started (monetization) with metadata.plan_id='mood_premium_yearly', metadata.source='apple', metadata.revenue_usd=79.0; legacy `analytics_events` collection count is unchanged for that user (confirms server-side standardization on user_events only). Apple webhook GATE is fail-closed: POST /api/subscription/webhooks/apple with {'signedPayload':'not.a.jws'} AND with {} both return 200 {ok:true, verified:false}, an apple_webhook_events audit doc with verified:false is written, and ZERO subscription_* events with metadata.notification_type are added to user_events (no spoofing). Catalog spot-check via /api/analytics/track confirms paywall_dismissed, plan_selected, purchase_initiated, restore_purchases_clicked, founding_member_offer_shown all map to category='monetization' and workout_generation_started/_completed/_previewed/_regenerated all map to category='workout'. Frontend funnel E2E (workout generation → cart) could NOT be exercised in the web preview because (a) the web preview frontend at https://pulse-sync-build.preview.emergentagent.com routes all API calls through EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://app-refine-1.preview.emergentagent.com which returns 404 for /api/* (boot health check & /api/me/entitlement both 404), and (b) HealthOnboardingGate hard-redirects authenticated users with planted token from /body-parts to /onboarding/health-connect — same blocker reported in iteration_39. Frontend plumbing source-code is confirmed correct (runTrackedGeneration wraps generation with workout_generation_started/_completed, cart.tsx calls Analytics.workoutPreviewed, regen path calls Analytics.workoutRegenerated). Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (warning in console; should migrate to expo-audio + expo-video).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL points to https://app-refine-1.preview.emergentagent.com which returns 404 for /api/* (verified via curl: /api/health → 404). The working backend is at https://pulse-sync-build.preview.emergentagent.com (same as EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). This breaks ALL frontend→backend calls in the web preview: AppBootstrap health check, /api/me/entitlement, /api/config all 404. Token-planted session validation also fails. This blocks any web-based UI E2E (including the generation funnel). Note: backend pytest hits localhost:8001 directly so plumbing is still verified; native/Expo Go build may bind to a different URL.

integration_issues.flow: Workout generation funnel via web preview
integration_issues.issue: HealthOnboardingGate (frontend/components/HealthOnboardingGate.tsx) router.replace('/onboarding/health-connect') intercepts every freshly-registered user, so direct navigation to /body-parts?mood=Muscle%20Gainer is redirected before any workout_generation_* event can fire from the UI. Same blocker as iteration_39. NOT a Phase 1 regression — pre-existing gating logic. UI funnel cannot be E2E exercised in web; verified code path only.
